Premium Economy Disclaimer

Premium Economy seat on ATR aircraft are subject to change as per Civil Aviation Safety Regulations when safety eligibility conditions are not met. We strive to accommodate all Passengers comfortably; however, safety eligibility conditions apply, including restrictions for children customers under age of 18 years and/or passengers with reduced mobility (PRMs). In such cases we will provide the next best available seat while ensuring the same Premium Economy service experience. For further clarification, please contact our customer service team at cc@iasl.aero.

Complimentary Snacks and Drinks may not be available for tickets issued within 5 hours of flight departure.
